title: Lectures notes on number theory for computer science
summary: This brief, in the form of an e-book, is a collection of notes that cover elementary and medium level number theory with a target audience of primarily computer science students. It can be used in the number theory portion of a discrete mathematics course, or a course on the mathematical foundations of computer science, or as background material for a cryptography course. Thematically it is split into five areas that map to chapters.
